system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, this is Yusuf Rossi. I just received my order #W2378156, and I’d like to request an exchange for a couple of items. 

First, the mechanical keyboard I got isn’t the switch type I wanted—I’d prefer the same model but with clicky switches. It’s important to me that it’s still full size and has RGB backlighting. If you don’t have a keyboard with all those features and clicky switches, I’d rather just exchange the thermostat.

Second, the smart thermostat I received is only compatible with Apple HomeKit, but I need one that works with Google Home instead. Could you help me with both exchanges? I want to make sure everything is sorted out in one go.

Let me know if you need any more details from me.

Thanks — I can help with that. First I need to authenticate you. Could you please confirm the zip code on your account (or give the email associated with the account)? Once I have that I’ll look up your user id and then check the order #W2378156 and available replacement items.
Sure, the zip code on my account is 19122. I actually don’t remember which email I used, but the zip should match. Let me know if you need any other info to verify my account.

Thanks — sorry about the hiccup. I tried to look up your account with the name + zip but the account lookup tool returned an error. Could you please provide the email associated with the account so I can authenticate you and pull up order #W2378156?

A few quick confirmations so I handle this exactly how you want once I can access your order:
- Keyboard exchange: you want the exact same model but with clicky switches, full size, and RGB backlighting. If a matching keyboard with clicky switches is not available, you want only the thermostat exchanged. Please confirm that preference.
- Thermostat exchange: you want a Google Home–compatible thermostat to replace the HomeKit-only one. Confirm that is correct.
- Do you want both exchanges handled together in one request? (You said “one go” — please confirm.)
- For any price difference or refund: do you prefer refunds to the original payment method, or to an existing gift card on your account? I’ll need this when we complete the exchange request.

If you’d rather I transfer you to a human agent now to handle the lookup, say so and I’ll connect you. Otherwise please reply with your email and the confirmations above and I’ll proceed.

Thanks for clarifying everything! Here are my confirmations:

- Yes, for the keyboard: I want the exact same model, but with clicky switches, full size, and RGB backlighting. If there isn’t a keyboard available that matches all those features with clicky switches, then I’d prefer to only exchange the thermostat and keep the keyboard as is.
- For the thermostat: Yes, I want to exchange the current one for a model that’s compatible with Google Home instead of Apple HomeKit.
- Yes, I’d like both exchanges handled together in one request, if possible.
- For any price difference or refund, please refund to my original payment method.

As for the email, I’m sorry but I really don’t remember which one I used for this order. Is there any other way to verify my account? If not, please transfer me to a human agent who might be able to help with the lookup another way. I just want to make sure this gets resolved smoothly.
